headerDisplay: Powers a Synology NAS on and off from HomeKit — Wake-on-LAN to turn it on, DSM to shut it down — and shows its temperature, CPU and memory load, storage health, how full its volumes are, its drives' temperatures and waiting DSM updates. Uses the DSM Web API with an administrator account without 2-step verification. Run it as a child bridge.
footerDisplay: For Wake-on-LAN, enable it on the NAS under Control Panel → Hardware & Power → General.

name.title: Name
name.description: The accessory's name in HomeKit. The NAS is remembered by it, so renaming it adds it to HomeKit anew.

host.title: Host
host.description: The NAS's IP address or name on the home network.

port.title: Port
port.description: DSM's port, as under Control Panel → Login Portal; 5001 if empty, or 5000 for HTTP.

checkCertificate.title: Check the certificate
checkCertificate.description: Only with a certificate valid for this host name. DSM's own is self-signed, which this would refuse.

username.title: Username
username.description: A DSM account in the administrators group, without 2-step verification — shutting down and restarting need one. Best a separate account just for this.

mac.title: MAC address
mac.description: For Wake-on-LAN. Without it the Power switch can shut the NAS down but not turn it on.

broadcast.title: Broadcast address
broadcast.description: Where the Wake-on-LAN packet is sent. The network's own, such as 10.0.1.255, if the default does not reach the NAS.

startupSeconds.title: Startup time (s)
startupSeconds.description: How long the Power switch stays on after waking the NAS before DSM must answer; 180 if empty.

shutdownSeconds.title: Shutdown time (s)
shutdownSeconds.description: How long the Power switch stays off after a shutdown while DSM still answers; 120 if empty.

cpu.title: CPU — a fan whose speed is the CPU load

memory.title: Memory — a fan whose speed is the memory in use

storage.title: Storage — a leak sensor that goes off when a volume, pool or drive is in trouble

update.title: DSM Update — an occupancy sensor, occupied while an update is waiting

restart.title: Restart — a switch that restarts the NAS

volumes.title: A humidity sensor per volume, showing how full it is

pollSeconds.title: Poll every (s)
pollSeconds.description: How often the plugin asks each NAS whether it is on and what it reads; 30 if empty, at least 10.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.description: A page with each NAS and its buttons, without login.

dashboardPort.title: Dashboard port
dashboardPort.description: The port of the dashboard; 8583 if empty.

dashboardControls.title: Buttons on the dashboard
dashboardControls.description: Power on, Shut down and Restart; they answer only devices on the home network. Off makes the page read only.
